name: notification-guard-rollback
method: one INSERT into app_notifications linked to an existing tagged test order inside BEGIN/ROLLBACK
limits: The remote probe covers the app_notifications BEFORE INSERT guard for an order linked to a tagged test order; it did not send a push or create a persistent row.
This does not exercise every notification producer or prove every mobile delivery channel, transaction path, retry, or concurrency case.
No fiscal document or SEFAZ request was involved.
